Name: Grampleton Fields Cleaner
Author: plankertonstorm
Description:
[size=4][b]What does it do?[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]A lightweight mod that clears all wild trees (at any growth stage) that have grown in the Grampleton Fields area each morning.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]How do I install this mod?[/b][/size]
Simply place the unzipped file inside of your 'Mods' folder and start your game.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI, Stardew Valley Expanded, Grampleton Fields addon

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[left]Compatible with most mods. This mod only removes wild
[code]Tree[/code]terrain features from the location
[code]Custom_GrampletonFields[/code]at the start of each day and doesnt change maps or content files.[/left]

[i]Note: After installing, sleeping is necessary to clean out existing trees in the area as the mod relies on the daystarted function. [/i]

Manifest.Name: Grampleton Cleaner
Manifest.Description: Removes wild trees from Grampleton Fields each morning.
